verdict.rationale: A state employment agency could plausibly publish a machine-readable format spec, such as wage-report file layouts, XML schemas, or a data dictionary, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only human-facing guidance: online filing through EAMS, PDF forms, and how-to videos. All OpenAPI candidate paths returned 404, and the transactional host sits behind an authentication wall, so there is no evidence of any published spec.
